name: x-api-mcp
description: Post, reply, thread, upload media and manage multiple X (Twitter) accounts through the official X API. Runs locally; tokens stay on your machine.

X_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth 2.0 Client ID of your own X App (console.x.com)

X_TOOLS.description: all (default) or write (posting and other write tools only)

X_AUTH_MODE.description: auto (default), loopback, or paste (browser on another device)

X_REQUIRE_ACCOUNT.description: 1 to refuse write calls that do not name the account

X_ENABLE_DM.description: 1 to request DM scopes and add DM tools (App needs Direct Messages permission)
